description: This file defines the IQueueCacheCursor interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which enumerates messages in a stream, providing methods to get the current message, move to the next, refresh the cursor, and record delivery failures.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current batch container and an exception if any occurred.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next message in the stream.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cache cursor with a new stream sequence token.

methods.name: RecordDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Records that delivery of the current event has failed.
